crossRefs.note: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
translations.bsb: Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus.
translations.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
translations.asv: And he, casting away his garment, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
